sloka: ऊरु पार्श्व कटी प्Rष्ठम् अन्योन्यस्य समाश्रिताः ।परस्पर निविष्ट अन्ग्यो मद स्नेह वश अनुगाः ॥५-९-६२॥
transliteration: ūru pārśva kaṭī pRṣṭham anyonyasya samāśritāḥ ।paraspara niviṣṭa angyo mada sneha vaśa anugāḥ ॥5-9-62॥

translations.english: Given to intoxication and sex, the women slept touching one another's thighs, sides, hips, back and lap of the other, with their limbs intertwined.
